use default

let limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do
    if !composite[factor] then
        let multiple mut = factor * factor

        while multiple <= limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

    if is_prime(lower) /\ is_prime(lower + 2) /\ is_square(sum) then

        write_line("  {lower} and {lower + 2} sum to {sum}, "

let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do

od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do

        let multiple mut = factor * factor

            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value > 1 /\ !composite[value]

is_square(value: int) -> bool =>
    (let root = cast int(System.Math.sqrt(cast(value))) in
     (root - 1::root + 1) |> any(side => side * side == value))

write_line("twin primes below ten million whose sum is a square:")

for lower in 2::limit - 2 do
    let sum = lower * 2 + 2

    if is_prime(lower) /\ is_prime(lower + 2) /\ is_square(sum) then
        let root = cast int(System.Math.sqrt(cast(sum)))

        write_line("  {lower} and {lower + 2} sum to {sum}, "
                   "which is {root} squared")
    fi
od
